column1: # The bundle of screens read by secret_prompt::tests. One screen per line:
# expected kind (none = no question) | cursor row | the screen's rows from the top.
# <blank> is an empty row. The rows are written from the prompts each tool
# prints (sudo, ssh, git, gpg, passwd, a PIN prompt, and the same in Korean,
# Japanese, Chinese and Spanish) and from the look-alikes ordinary output shows.
# Questions: a secret is asked on the cursor's row, which is the last row with text.
# Look-alikes: the same words in ordinary output, or a question that is not
# waiting. None of these is a question, so none may put a secret box up.
